payload.question: The minister's remarks were deliberately ___, allowing her to deny any specific commitment later.
payload.explanation_uz: Equivocal — ikki ma'noli, noaniq. Emphatic (qat'iy), lucid (tushunarli) va candid (ochiq) esa aynan aksini bildiradi, shuning uchun majburiyatni keyin inkor etib bo'lmasdi.

payload.question: After the scandal, the once-celebrated senator became a political ___, shunned by his former allies.
payload.explanation_uz: Pariah — jamiyat chetlagan, quvilgan shaxs. Paragon (namuna), patron (homiy) va proxy (vakil) 'chetlangan' ma'nosiga mos kelmaydi.

payload.question: A ___ arbitrator, with no personal stake in the outcome, was appointed to settle the dispute.
payload.explanation_uz: Disinterested — xolis, manfaatsiz. Uninterested (qiziqmaydigan), unconcerned (befarq) va listless (loqayd) xolislikni emas, qiziqishning yo'qligini bildiradi.

payload.question: After months of hype, the product launch proved a damp ___, revealing nothing new.
payload.explanation_uz: Damp squib — kutilgan ta'sirni bermagan, puchga chiqqan voqea (idioma). Boshqa so'zlar bu barqaror birikmada ishlatilmaydi.

payload.question: The judge issued an ___ preventing the company from disposing of its assets.
payload.explanation_uz: Injunction — sudning biror ishni taqiqlovchi qarori. Indictment (ayblov xulosasi), affidavit (qasamyod bilan guvohlik) va subpoena (chaqiruv qog'ozi) taqiq ma'nosini bermaydi.

payload.question: Unlike the chronic condition, the side effects were ___, vanishing within a few hours.
payload.explanation_uz: Transient — o'tkinchi, qisqa muddatli. Latent (yashirin), pernicious (zararli) va inherent (tabiiy, ajralmas) tez yo'qolishni anglatmaydi.

payload.question: Critics found the novel's ending ___, a tidy resolution that sat awkwardly with its morally ambiguous tone.
payload.explanation_uz: Contrived — sun'iy, uydirma. Cogent (ishonarli), nascent (endi tug'ilayotgan) va seminal (yo'l ochuvchi) 'o'rinsiz silliq yakun' fikriga mos emas.

payload.question: The prime minister was accused of being ___, refusing to reconsider even as the evidence against his policy mounted.
payload.explanation_uz: Obdurate — o'jar, qaysar (salbiy tus). Resolute, steadfast va tenacious deyarli sinonim, lekin ijobiy tusli ('qat'iyatli'), 'accused' bilan mos kelmaydi.

payload.question: The company's ___ in the face of falling sales, its refusal to alter course, proved costly.
payload.explanation_uz: Intransigence — murosasizlik, qaysarlik. Impetus (turtki), nonchalance (beparvolik) va ingenuity (zukkolik) 'yo'nalishni o'zgartirmaslik' ma'nosini bermaydi.

payload.question: The minister tried to ___ the regulation by routing the funds through an overseas subsidiary.
payload.explanation_uz: Circumvent — (qoidani) chetlab o'tmoq. Contravene (to'g'ridan-to'g'ri buzmoq), supersede (o'rnini bosmoq) va abrogate (bekor qilmoq) hiyla bilan aylanib o'tishni bildirmaydi.

payload.question: Without any evidence, it is unfair to ___ aspersions on her integrity.
payload.explanation_uz: Cast aspersions on — birovga tuhmat qilmoq, obro'siga soya solmoq. Boshqa fe'llar bu turg'un birikmada ishlatilmaydi.

payload.question: The reforms were largely ___, rearranging the deckchairs on the Titanic while the underlying problems went untouched.
payload.explanation_uz: Cosmetic — yuzaki, tashqi ko'rinish uchun qilingan. Radical (tub), systemic (tizimli) va seminal (muhim) asosiy muammolar tegilmagan degan ma'noga zid.

payload.question: The newspaper's editorial ___ the government's handling of the crisis, calling it negligent and incompetent.
payload.explanation_uz: Excoriated — qattiq tanqid qildi. Exonerated (oqladi) va extolled (maqtadi) aksini bildiradi; extrapolated (taxmin qildi) ma'noga umuman mos emas.

payload.question: Her ___ rise from obscurity to international fame took barely eighteen months.
payload.explanation_uz: Meteoric — meteordek tez ko'tarilgan. Gradual (asta-sekin), tentative (ikkilanib) va laborious (mashaqqatli) 'bir yarim yilda' tezligiga zid.

payload.question: The new policy will ___ the gap between rich and poor unless it is offset by tax reform.
payload.explanation_uz: Exacerbate — (muammoni) og'irlashtirmoq, kuchaytirmoq. Exasperate (jahlini chiqarmoq) odamga, exaggerate (bo'rttirmoq) va exhilarate (ruhlantirmoq) esa bu ma'noga mos emas.

payload.question: The scheme was designed to ___ a fundamental change in how schools are funded.
payload.explanation_uz: Effect (fe'l) — amalga oshirmoq, yuzaga keltirmoq. Affect faqat ta'sir qilmoq degani, infect (yuqtirmoq), defect (qochib o'tmoq) mos emas.

payload.question: The tabloid's remarks were plainly ___, exposing it to a libel suit.
payload.explanation_uz: Defamatory — tuhmat qiluvchi, obro'ga putur yetkazuvchi. Deferential (hurmatli), derivative (taqlidiy) va defunct (tugatilgan) libel (tuhmat) da'vosiga olib kelmaydi.

payload.question: Fleming's discovery of penicillin was ___: he noticed the mould on a discarded dish by pure chance.
payload.explanation_uz: Serendipitous — tasodifan topilgan omadli. Systematic (tizimli) va deliberate (ataylab) 'tasodif' ga zid; ephemeral (o'tkinchi) mos emas.

payload.question: In his later years he grew ___, avoiding company and rarely leaving his study.
payload.explanation_uz: Reclusive — dunyodan chetlashgan, yolg'izlikni yoqtiradigan. Loquacious (gapdon), gregarious (odamovi emas, ko'pchilikni yoqtiradigan) va ebullient (shod-xurram) aksini bildiradi.

payload.question: The ___ of reliable data makes any firm conclusion impossible.
payload.explanation_uz: Paucity — kamlik, yetishmovchilik. Plethora, surfeit va profusion — 'ortiqcha, mo'l-ko'llik' bo'lib, 'xulosa qilib bo'lmaslik' bilan zid.

payload.question: He refused to ___ his words, telling the board bluntly that the project had failed.
payload.explanation_uz: Not to mince words — gapni yumshatmay, ochiq aytmoq (idioma). Chew, grind va shred bu birikmada ishlatilmaydi.

payload.question: Defence counsel asked that the proceedings be ___ until fresh evidence could be examined.
payload.explanation_uz: Adjourned — (majlis) keyinga qoldirildi. Abdicated (taxtdan voz kechdi), adjudged (hukm qilindi) va adjured (qattiq iltimos qildi) jarayonga mos emas.

payload.question: He is known for his ___ wit: cutting, unsparing, and capable of leaving its victims quietly humiliated.
payload.explanation_uz: Caustic — achchiq tilli, nish urgan. Cordial (samimiy), benign (zararsiz) va whimsical (hazil-mutoyiba) 'ayovsiz' ta'rifiga zid.

payload.question: The drug is ___ in young children, so doctors must not prescribe it to under-twelves.
payload.explanation_uz: Contraindicated — qo'llash man etilgan (tibbiy atama). Boshqa so'zlar dori vositasi haqida bu ma'noni bermaydi.

payload.question: The scholar's ___ style, bloated with jargon, obscured otherwise valuable ideas.
payload.explanation_uz: Turgid — shishirilgan, dabdabali va og'ir uslub. Lucid (ravshan), succinct (lo'nda) va limpid (tiniq) aksini bildiradi.

payload.text: Critics condemned the ___ of the wedding, with its gold-plated carriages and fireworks. (ostentatious)
payload.explanation_uz: Ostentation — dabdaba, ko'z-ko'z qilish. -ious sifatdan -ation oti hosil bo'ladi.

payload.text: The ___ of his expression made negotiating with him exceptionally difficult. (inscrutable)
payload.explanation_uz: Inscrutability — sirliligi, o'qib bo'lmasligi. Sifat inscrutable dan -ability qo'shimchasi bilan ot yasaladi.

payload.text: The ___ in the clause allowed it to be read in two quite different ways. (ambiguous)
payload.explanation_uz: Ambiguity — ikki ma'nolilik. -ous sifatdan -ity bilan ot yasaladi.

payload.text: It would be highly ___ to sign the contract without having it checked by a lawyer. (prudent)
payload.explanation_uz: Imprudent — ehtiyotsiz, oqilona emas. im- inkor prefiksi prudent (ehtiyotkor) ni teskarisiga o'giradi.

payload.text: The tribunal remained ___ to the applicant's plight, rejecting her appeal without comment. (sympathy)
payload.explanation_uz: Unsympathetic — hamdardlik bildirmaydigan. Ot sympathy dan un- + -etic sifati yasaladi.

payload.text: After the flood, the flat was declared ___ and the tenants were rehoused. (inhabit)
payload.explanation_uz: Uninhabitable — yashashga yaroqsiz. un- + inhabit + -able.

payload.text: The victor's ___ in sparing his rivals impressed even his enemies. (magnanimous)
payload.explanation_uz: Magnanimity — olijanoblik, saxiylik. -ous sifat -ity ot ga aylanadi.

payload.text: Statisticians questioned the ___ of the survey, since it relied on self-reported data. (reliable)
payload.explanation_uz: Reliability — ishonchlilik. -able sifati -ability bilan ot bo'ladi.

payload.text: The charity's ___ was beyond reproach; every donation was audited and published. (integral)
payload.explanation_uz: Integrity — halollik, benuqsonlik. Integral so'zidan farqli, integrity ot bo'lib 'vijdonlilik' degani.

payload.text: The long delay led to a further ___ of tensions between the two sides. (exacerbate)
payload.explanation_uz: Exacerbation — (ziddiyatlarning) kuchayishi. Fe'l + -ation orqali ot yasaladi.

payload.text: Her ___ in pursuing the case through three appeals finally secured justice. (tenacious)
payload.explanation_uz: Tenacity — qat'iyat, matonat. -ious sifati -ity bilan ot bo'ladi.

payload.text: It would be ___ of me to speak on her behalf without being asked. (presume)
payload.explanation_uz: Presumptuous — o'zboshimcha, haddan oshgan. Presume (taxmin qilmoq) fe'lidan -uous sifati yasaladi.

payload.text: After the merger, over two hundred staff were made ___. (redundancy)
payload.explanation_uz: Redundant — ortiqcha, ishdan bo'shatilgan. Redundancy otidan sifat shakli kerak.

payload.text: Voters were angered by the ___ of a minister who preached austerity while claiming lavish expenses. (hypocrite)
payload.explanation_uz: Hypocrisy — riyokorlik. Hypocrite (riyokor odam) dan ot hypocrisy yasaladi.

payload.text: Planned ___ forces consumers to replace perfectly good devices every few years. (obsolete)
payload.explanation_uz: Obsolescence — eskirish, eskirib qolish. Obsolete sifatidan -escence bilan ot hosil bo'ladi.

payload.text: His ___ in refusing any compromise eventually cost him the election. (obstinate)
payload.explanation_uz: Obstinacy – o'jarlik, qaysarlik. -ate sifati -acy bilan ot bo'ladi.

payload.text: She was accused of ___ after concealing the true scale of the losses from shareholders. (deceive)
payload.explanation_uz: Deception/deceit — aldov, yolg'on. Deceive (aldamoq) fe'lidan ikkala ot ham to'g'ri.

payload.text: The proposal withstood close ___ by the committee. (scrutinise)
payload.explanation_uz: Scrutiny — sinchkovlik bilan tekshirish. Fe'ldan farqli, ot shakli -y bilan tugaydi.

payload.text: The ___ of unregulated apps has alarmed consumer-protection agencies. (proliferate)
payload.explanation_uz: Proliferation — tez ko'payish. Fe'l + -ation orqali ot yasaladi.

payload.text: As a ___ objector, he refused military service on moral grounds. (conscience)
payload.explanation_uz: Conscientious objector — vijdoniy e'tiroz bildiruvchi (turg'un birikma). Conscience otidan -ious sifati yasaladi.
